_note: Updated content for the 8th Year (2026). Timeline arranged in reverse chronological order (latest first).

about.odia: ଶ୍ରୀ ଗଜାନନ ପୂଜା କମିଟି, ମିର୍ଜାପୁର ଓ ପାରିପୁଣ୍ଡିଲୋ ଏକ ସାମାଜିକ, ସାଂସ୍କୃତିକ ଓ ଧାର୍ମିକ ସଂଗଠନ ୨୦୧୯ ମସିହାରୁ ଆମେ ପ୍ରତିବର୍ଷ ଭକ୍ତି, ଏକତା ଓ ପରମ୍ପରାର ସହ ଭବ୍ୟ ଗଣେଶ ପୂଜା ମହୋତ୍ସବର ଆୟୋଜନ କରିଆସୁଛୁ।
about.en: Shree Gajanan Puja Committee, Mirjapur & Paripundilo, is a social, cultural, and religious organisation. Since 2019, we have been celebrating the annual Ganesh Puja Mahotsav, bringing the community together through devotion, unity, and tradition.

timeline.milestoneEn: Celebrating the 8th Annual Shree Gajanan Puja Mahotsav.
Successfully celebrated the 7th Annual Shree Gajanan Puja with enthusiastic community participation.
The festival continued to grow with increasing community participation.
Devotees came together to celebrate Lord Ganesha with faith and devotion.
The tradition grew stronger with the support of volunteers and devotees.
The celebration continued with unwavering faith and community spirit.
A simple yet memorable celebration reflected resilience and devotion.
The first Shree Gajanan Puja marked the beginning of a cherished tradition.

announcement.en: 🎉 Welcome to the 8th Annual Shree Gajanan Puja Mahotsav 2026. Join us in seeking the blessings of Lord Ganesha.
announcement.odia: 🎉 ଶ୍ରୀ ଗଜାନନ ପୂଜା ମହୋତ୍ସବର ୮ମ ବର୍ଷ (୨୦୨୬) କୁ ସ୍ୱାଗତ। ଆସନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରଭୁ ଶ୍ରୀ ଗଜାନନଙ୍କ ଆଶୀର୍ବାଦ ଲାଭ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଆମ ସହ ସାମିଲ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
